question: Please list the display names of all the users who owns a post that is well-finished.
evidence: the post that is well-finished refers to ClosedDate IS NOT Null
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
gold: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE NOT T1.ClosedDate IS NULL
gold0: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL

b.request: List the display name from `users` for each post with a non-NULL `ClosedDate`, keeping posts with no matching `users` record and showing a NULL display name for them
b.sql: SELECT users.DisplayName FROM posts LEFT JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL

d.request: List the display names of users who own posts with a non-null ClosedDate, including qualifying posts with no matching user record.
d.sql: SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
